name: 0 · The Fool
imagery: A young traveller in a bright, flower-patterned tunic steps toward the edge of a cliff, eyes lifted to the sky, a white rose in one hand and a small bundle on a staff over his shoulder. A little white dog leaps at his heels and a white sun blazes behind him, with icy peaks in the distance. The white rose speaks of pure intention, the bundle of everything he needs carried lightly, the dog of loyal instinct, and the cliff of the leap of faith every true beginning asks for.
meaning: The Fool is the zero, the open circle before the story begins, and he arrives when life is inviting you to say yes to something new. This card blesses fresh starts, unplanned adventures, and the kind of trust that lets you step forward before you can see the whole path. It asks you to travel light, to meet the world with curiosity rather than cynicism, and to let wonder be your compass. There is wisdom in this innocence: the Fool is protected by his openness and by the instinct that trots beside him. Pack only what you truly need, glance at the edge so you know it is there, and then take the step with an open heart.
astrology: Uranus (Golden Dawn: the element of Air)
numerology: Zero is pure potential, the void before creation and the egg of the cosmos; it holds every number within it and belongs to no fixed place in the sequence.
affirmation: I trust the path that rises to meet my feet.

ctx.past: Your story here began with a leap, a moment when you said yes to something without knowing where it would lead. That brave, perhaps naive beginning still colours the situation, and the freshness and trust you brought then are part of why things stand as they do now.
ctx.present: You are standing at the cliff's edge right now, with the sun at your back and a whole unknown landscape ahead. Something new is asking for your yes. The heart of the matter is less about planning every detail and more about whether you are willing to trust yourself enough to begin.
ctx.future: A fresh start is coming toward you, the kind that feels a little dizzying and a lot like freedom. Expect an invitation, a journey, or a sudden opening that resets the board. Meet it with curiosity, carry only what you truly need, and you will find yourself on a new road.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is the Fool's shadow: leaping without looking, ignoring the little dog barking at your heels. Carelessness, restlessness, or avoiding commitment may be tripping you up. Keep your sense of wonder, but glance at the ground before you step, and listen when your instincts urge caution.
ctx.advice: Begin before you feel ready. Pack light, keep your intention as clean as the Fool's white rose, and take the first small step toward the thing that excites you. You do not need the whole map; you need willingness, a little faith, and an eye on the sky.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a beginner right now, open, eager, maybe unsure of the rules. Honour that inner child who still believes anything is possible. Your freshness is not a weakness here; it is exactly what lets you notice doors that more jaded people walk straight past.
ctx.others: Those around you may see you as carefree, spontaneous, or a little unpredictable. Alternatively, someone in your environment is bringing fresh energy, a newcomer or free spirit who shakes up the routine. Their lightness can be contagious, so let it loosen what has grown too rigid.
ctx.hopes: You long for freedom, a clean slate, a chance to start over without the weight of the past. You may also fear that leap, worried about looking foolish or falling. Notice how close the hope and the fear sit together; often the thing that scares you is the very doorway you wished for.
ctx.love: In love, the Fool brings new romance, playful flirtation, or a relationship that feels like an adventure. It favours spontaneity, laughter, and falling for someone without overthinking it. In an existing bond, it suggests rediscovering the giddy curiosity you had at the start, perhaps through travel or trying something new together.
ctx.work: At work, this card points to a new venture, a career change, or a creative project you start from scratch. Risks may feel worth it now, but keep your bundle sensibly packed and do basic research before you jump. Beginner's mind can spark original ideas others would never think to try.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is inviting you to trust the unseen. Your guides are reminding you that you are held, even when the ground seems to disappear beneath you. This is a message about faith in the journey of the soul, the sacred foolishness of saying yes to life and letting it surprise you.
ctx.release: It is time to let go of excessive caution, the need to know every outcome before you begin. Release old stories about being too inexperienced, too late, or too old to start. Leave behind the heavy baggage the Fool never carries, and notice how much lighter your steps feel.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface may be a fear of commitment dressed up as freedom, or a restless urge to escape rather than grow. You may also be secretly yearning for adventure but suppressing it. Ask whether your hesitation is wisdom or simply the fear of being a beginner again.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a desire for something new, an impulse toward freedom and possibility. The whole matter rests on a leap of faith, either one already taken or one waiting to happen. Everything else grows from that core willingness to step into the unknown.
ctx.gift: Your gift is fearless openness. You can see possibilities others have stopped noticing, and the universe tends to support those who move with trust. Hidden help may come through chance meetings, lucky timing, or simply your willingness to try, so let your innocence be your strength.

name: I · The Magician
imagery: A robed figure stands before a table holding the four suit symbols: a wand, a cup, a sword, and a pentacle. One hand raises a double-tipped wand toward the heavens while the other points to the earth, an infinity symbol floats above his head, and roses and lilies bloom around him. The gesture embodies 'as above, so below', channelling spiritual power into physical form, while the tools show that every element needed for creation is already at hand.
meaning: The Magician is the moment when potential becomes action, when you gather your will and make something real. Everything you need is on the table before you: your passion, your feelings, your intellect, and your practical resources. This card affirms your skill and your power to manifest, especially through focused intention, clear communication, and deliberate effort. It is a card of spellwork in the truest sense, aligning thought, word, and deed until the world responds. Name what you want, pick up your tools, and act with confidence, because the current is flowing through you now.
numerology: One is the number of initiation, will, and individuality, the first spark of action and the single point from which all creation unfolds.
affirmation: I have everything I need to create what I desire.

ctx.past: Something you deliberately set in motion is shaping the present. A past decision, skill you developed, or intention you clearly spoke into being laid the groundwork. You already proved you can manifest when you focus, and that history of capability is a resource to draw on now.
ctx.present: Right now, you are in a position of real power. All four tools are on your table, your will is sharp, and the channel between idea and outcome is wide open. The heart of the matter is that you can make this happen, if you choose to act with focus.
ctx.future: A period of strong momentum and successful manifestation is coming. Plans you have been nurturing are ready to become real, and you will find you have the skill and resources to carry them out. Expect opportunities to show what you can do and to be recognised for it.
ctx.challenge: The Magician's shadow is power misdirected: scattered focus, manipulation, or talking a bigger game than you play. You may also be underusing your gifts out of self-doubt. Check that your intentions are clean and that you are not using clever words to avoid the real work of creation.
ctx.advice: Gather your tools and use them. Set a clear intention, write it down or speak it aloud, and then take one concrete action today that moves it into the world. Combine your heart, mind, passion, and practical sense, and do not wait for permission to begin.
ctx.self: You see yourself as capable and resourceful, or you are being asked to claim that identity. Your hand is raised and the current is ready. Trust your talents, stand tall at your altar, and remember that confidence grounded in real skill is a form of magic.
ctx.others: Others may see you as competent, persuasive, and full of initiative, the person who makes things happen. Or there is someone around you who is skilled and influential, perhaps a mentor or dealmaker. Watch whether their charisma is helpful or a little too slick to fully trust.
ctx.hopes: You hope to make your dreams real and prove your abilities, to feel that your efforts genuinely change things. You may fear that you lack the skill or that your power will fall flat. Remember the tools already on your table; the fear is usually louder than the facts.
ctx.love: In love, the Magician brings charm, chemistry, and the power to create the relationship you want through honest communication. Say what you desire clearly. It can signal an attraction to someone magnetic; just make sure the magic is genuine and the words match the actions over time.
ctx.work: This is an excellent card for career and craft. Your skills are in demand, and initiatives you launch now have strong backing. It favours pitches, negotiations, new projects, and entrepreneurial moves. Lead with competence, communicate clearly, and turn ideas into tangible results.
ctx.spirit: Spirit reminds you that you are a channel between heaven and earth. Your guides are encouraging you to practise your craft, whether ritual, prayer, or creative work, and to trust that your intentions carry weight. As above, so below: align your will with the divine and act.
ctx.release: Let go of the belief that you are powerless or that you must wait for someone else to make things happen. Release scattered efforts and half-finished spells. Clear the table of anything you are not truly using, so the tools that matter can do their work.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be an unrecognised talent you have not dared to use, or a quiet hunger for control. Perhaps you are manipulating a situation without fully admitting it, even to yourself. Look honestly at how you use your influence and where you have been hiding your gifts.
ctx.foundation: At the root of the matter lies willpower and intention. This situation was built by someone's deliberate choice, possibly your own. Its core is the question of how you are using your abilities and whether thought, word, and action are truly aligned.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the power to manifest. You have more skill, ingenuity, and resourcefulness than you are giving yourself credit for. Hidden help comes through your own talents and the right words at the right moment, so trust that you can shape this outcome.

name: II · The High Priestess
imagery: A serene priestess sits between two pillars, the black Boaz and the white Jachin, before a veil embroidered with pomegranates that hides a glimpse of water. She wears a lunar crown, a crescent moon rests at her feet, a solar cross sits on her breast, and she holds a scroll marked TORA, partly concealed in her robes. The pillars show the balance of opposites, the veil and partly hidden scroll the mysteries revealed only to those who look within, and the moon her rule over intuition and the tides of the psyche.
meaning: The High Priestess guards the threshold between the known and the hidden, and she asks you to trust what you sense beneath the surface. This is a card of intuition, dreams, quiet wisdom, and knowledge that cannot be rushed or forced. Rather than acting, she invites you to be still, to listen, and to let the answers rise from the deep water of your inner self. Something may still be veiled, and that is fine; not everything is meant to be known yet. Pay attention to synchronicities, dreams, and the soft voice that already knows what you need.
numerology: Two is the number of duality, receptivity, and balance, the space between opposites where reflection and intuition arise.
affirmation: I trust the quiet voice within that already knows.

ctx.past: Your intuition has been guiding this situation from the start, perhaps more than you realised. A hunch, dream, or quiet knowing you felt earlier was accurate. Something was also kept hidden or unspoken in the past, and its influence still ripples through the waters behind the veil.
ctx.present: You are being asked to pause and listen inward rather than push outward. The heart of the matter is not fully visible yet, and that is part of the lesson. Trust what you feel more than what you are told, and give the answers time to surface.
ctx.future: A deepening of intuition and spiritual insight is coming. Hidden information may come to light, or a dream or sign will reveal what you need to know. Expect a period that rewards patience, reflection, and trust in your own inner wisdom over outside opinions.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is withdrawal or secrecy taken too far: holding everything inside, ignoring your gut, or waiting so long in stillness that you never act. You may be disconnected from your intuition or afraid of what you would see behind the veil. Gently lift it and look.
ctx.advice: Get quiet. Meditate, journal, keep a dream diary, or simply sit by water and listen. Do not reveal all your plans just yet, and do not force a decision. The answer is already within you; your task is to create enough stillness to hear it.
ctx.self: You see yourself as perceptive, private, and deeply intuitive, someone who knows more than they say. Honour that inner priestess. Your reserved nature is not coldness; it is a sacred boundary that protects your inner world and lets wisdom ripen.
ctx.others: Others may find you mysterious, hard to read, or quietly wise. Alternatively, there is someone in your environment who holds knowledge or keeps their own counsel, perhaps a wise woman, teacher, or someone with secrets. Not everything is being shared openly; read between the lines.
ctx.hopes: You long for deeper understanding, spiritual connection, and clarity about what is hidden. You may also fear what lies behind the veil, or worry that your intuition cannot be trusted. Both hope and fear point to the same call: to honour your inner knowing.
ctx.love: In love, the High Priestess speaks of deep, unspoken connection, attraction with mystery, or feelings not yet expressed. A partner or love interest may be holding something back. Trust your intuition about the bond and allow intimacy to unfold slowly, without forcing confessions.
ctx.work: At work, keep your cards close to your chest for now. Gather information quietly, trust your instincts about people and projects, and avoid rushing decisions. This card favours research, study, counselling, and intuitive or spiritual work. Hidden facts may soon change the picture.
ctx.spirit: This is a powerful sign of spiritual connection. Your guides speak through dreams, symbols, and the moon's cycles. You are being called to deepen your practice, perhaps through divination, meditation, or lunar ritual. The priestess herself is a guardian at the gate of mysteries.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to know everything right now and of relying solely on logic or outside approval. Release the habit of overriding your gut. You can also release secrets that no longer serve you, letting the veil fall where honesty would bring peace.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here is information you have not yet accessed, either withheld by others or buried in your own subconscious. You may know more than you are admitting to yourself. Dreams and quiet moments will reveal this blind spot if you are willing to look gently.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies intuition and the unknown. What is truly driving things is beneath the surface, in feelings, instincts, or facts not yet revealed. Understanding comes not from analysing harder, but from listening to the deep water within.
ctx.gift: Your gift is intuition. You have a strong inner compass and a natural connection to the unseen. Hidden help comes through dreams, signs, and gut feelings, so trust them. Your ability to sit with mystery without panic is a rare and powerful blessing.

name: III · The Empress
imagery: A crowned woman reclines on plush cushions in a lush garden, wearing a gown patterned with pomegranates and a crown of twelve stars. A heart-shaped shield bears the glyph of Venus, golden wheat ripens at her feet, and a stream and forest flow behind her. The wheat and pomegranates speak of fertility and harvest, the twelve stars of her reign over the cycles of the year, and the flowing water of life-giving abundance.
meaning: The Empress is the great mother, the green earth in full bloom, and she brings a season of growth, comfort, and creative abundance. This card asks you to nurture, whether that means caring for others, tending a project, or lavishing yourself with the kind of love you give so freely. She celebrates the senses: good food, beauty, touch, rest, and time spent in nature. Creativity flows easily now, and whatever you plant with care is likely to grow. Slow down, let yourself receive, and trust that you are allowed to flourish.
numerology: Three is the number of creation and growth, the union of two that births something new, expression, and expansion.
affirmation: I am abundant, and I allow myself to bloom.

ctx.past: This situation grew from fertile soil: love, nurturing, or a creative season that bore fruit. A mother figure or caring presence may have shaped your foundations. You were given, or gave, something that nourished growth, and that warmth is still feeding what stands now.
ctx.present: You are in a fertile, abundant phase. Life is ripe with creative potential, comfort, and opportunities to nurture something you love. The heart of the matter is care: of yourself, others, or a project. Let yourself enjoy this harvest instead of rushing past it.
ctx.future: A season of growth and abundance is coming. Projects will flourish, relationships deepen, and comfort increases. This can also point to pregnancy, birth, or the arrival of a creative project. Keep tending your garden; what you plant now will bloom generously.
ctx.challenge: The Empress's shadow is smothering or over-giving, losing yourself in caring for everyone else, or overindulgence that turns comfort into stagnation. You may be blocked creatively or neglecting your own needs. Nurture yourself as tenderly as you nurture others.
ctx.advice: Reconnect with your body and with the earth. Walk in nature, cook something nourishing, create with your hands, and allow yourself pleasure without guilt. Nurture your projects with patience. Growth happens in its own season, and gentle care is more powerful than force.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a nurturer, creator, or caretaker, warm, generous, and sensual. You are being reminded that you deserve the same abundance you give. Embrace your creative, fertile side and let yourself be the queen of your own lush garden.
ctx.others: Others see you as warm, comforting, and generous, someone people gather around. Or there is a nurturing figure in your environment, perhaps a mother, mentor, or friend who offers comfort and support. Their care can help you grow if you accept it.
ctx.hopes: You hope for abundance, comfort, love, and maybe a family or creative legacy. You may fear scarcity, being unable to provide, or not being nurtured in return. Know that the Empress's gift is real and closer than you think; you can begin by mothering yourself.
ctx.love: In love, the Empress is deeply favourable, bringing affection, romance, sensuality, and devotion. Relationships feel nourishing and secure. She can indicate a desire for family, commitment, or children. Express love through touch, care, and shared pleasures that feed both partners.
ctx.work: At work, this card signals growth, creativity, and fruitful projects. Your efforts are likely to be rewarded, especially in creative, caring, artistic, or nature-based fields. Invest patiently in what you are building and create a workplace that feels supportive and beautiful.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through the earth itself. The Great Mother, Venus, or a nature goddess may be calling you. Ground your practice in the land, the seasons, and the body. Garden witchcraft, herbal work, or simply honouring the cycles of nature will deepen your connection.
ctx.release: Let go of the belief that you must earn rest or that receiving is selfish. Release scarcity thinking and harsh self-criticism about your body. Leave behind relationships or habits that drain you instead of nourishing you, and make room for genuine abundance.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a longing to be cared for that you have not admitted, or creative gifts left unexpressed. You might be over-giving to avoid your own needs. Notice where you neglect yourself, and where dependence or control hides beneath the label of care.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies nurturing, love, and creative growth. It is built on care given or received, and its core is about fertility in every sense, of ideas, relationships, or life itself. What you nourish here has the power to flourish.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to grow things, whether gardens, people, ideas, or love. You bring warmth and abundance wherever you go. Hidden help comes through nature, creativity, and nurturing people, so let yourself receive the support that is being offered.

name: IV · The Emperor
imagery: A bearded ruler in armour beneath a red robe sits upon a stone throne carved with four ram heads, holding an ankh-topped sceptre and a golden orb. Barren red mountains rise behind him, with only a thin stream at their foot. The rams link him to Aries and drive, the armour to readiness and protection, the ankh and orb to dominion over life and the world, and the stark mountains to the hard-won stability of structure and discipline.
meaning: The Emperor is the builder of kingdoms, the steady hand that turns chaos into order. He brings structure, boundaries, leadership, and the discipline needed to make dreams last. This card asks you to take charge of your life, set clear rules for yourself, and protect what matters with calm strength. He can also represent a father figure, a boss, or any authority, and invites you to consider your relationship with power. True sovereignty means responsibility: when you build a solid foundation, you create safety for yourself and for everyone who depends on you.
numerology: Four is the number of foundation and stability, the square and the four corners of the world, bringing order, structure, and endurance.
affirmation: I build a life of strength, order, and protection.

ctx.past: This situation was shaped by structure, rules, or an authority figure, perhaps a father, boss, or institution. A firm decision or disciplined effort in the past built the foundation that holds things up now, for better or for worse. Notice which of those rules still serve you.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter calls for leadership and order. You are being asked to take responsibility, set boundaries, and make decisions with a steady head. Chaos will not resolve itself; it needs someone willing to sit on the throne and organise the kingdom.
ctx.future: Stability and security are coming. Your efforts will create a solid structure, whether a business, a home, or a well-ordered routine. You may step into a leadership role or gain the support of an influential person. What you build now is built to last.
ctx.challenge: The Emperor's shadow is rigidity and control, holding on so tightly to rules that warmth and flexibility vanish. Domination, stubbornness, or a harsh authority figure may be blocking you. You might also be struggling to own your own power. Lead, but leave room for the stream.
ctx.advice: Create structure. Make a plan, set firm boundaries, and follow through with discipline. Take ownership of your choices instead of waiting for someone else to rule. Be the protective, fair leader you wish you had, both for yourself and for those in your care.
ctx.self: You see yourself as responsible, capable, and in control, or you are being asked to step into that role. Embrace your inner ruler. You can be both strong and kind; authority does not require coldness, only clarity and the willingness to stand firm.
ctx.others: Others view you as dependable, authoritative, maybe a little stern. Alternatively, there is a powerful figure in your environment, a boss, parent, or official, whose decisions shape your situation. Engage with them respectfully but do not give away your own sovereignty.
ctx.hopes: You hope for security, stability, and the respect of others, a kingdom you can call your own. You may fear losing control, being dominated, or failing as a provider. Remember that true stability comes from inner structure, not from controlling everything around you.
ctx.love: In love, the Emperor brings commitment, loyalty, and a protective partner. Relationships may become more stable or formalised. Be mindful of power dynamics, though; a healthy bond balances strength with tenderness. Clear agreements and mutual respect will help love feel safe.
ctx.work: At work, this is a strong card for leadership, promotion, and building something lasting. Organise your systems, establish clear goals, and lead with confidence. It favours business ownership, management, and dealing with institutions. Discipline now leads to long-term success.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of sacred sovereignty and right action. Your guides may be urging you to bring structure to your practice, with regular ritual, study, and clear boundaries with the unseen. Protective energies surround you, and you are being asked to claim spiritual authority over your own path.
ctx.release: Let go of rigid control and outdated rules that no longer fit who you are. Release the need to dominate or to be dominated, and leave behind authority figures whose approval you no longer need. Keep the structure that serves you and let the rest crumble.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of chaos that drives you to over-control, or unresolved feelings about a father figure or authority. You may be suppressing your own leadership out of fear of being seen as harsh. Look at how power works in you and around you.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies the need for order, security, and protection. It is built on structure, rules, or someone's authority. Understanding who holds power here, and how it is used, will reveal what is truly underneath the matter.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to create order out of chaos. You have a natural capacity for leadership, discipline, and protection. Hidden help comes through structure, planning, and supportive authorities, and you have the strength to build something truly lasting.

name: V · The Hierophant
imagery: A religious figure in red robes and a triple crown sits between two grey pillars, raising his right hand in benediction and holding a triple cross. Two crossed keys lie at his feet, and two tonsured acolytes kneel before him. The keys unlock the mysteries of heaven and earth, the triple crown and cross signal authority over the three worlds, and the kneeling disciples show the passing of sacred knowledge from teacher to student.
meaning: The Hierophant is the keeper of sacred tradition, the bridge between ancient wisdom and the seeker who comes to learn. This card speaks of teachers, mentors, rituals, shared beliefs, and the institutions that hold a community together. It may call you to study a path more deeply, honour your lineage, or find guidance from someone who has walked the road before you. It can also ask you to examine which traditions truly nourish your spirit and which you follow out of habit. When you learn the old ways with an open heart, you gain keys that unlock doors for a lifetime.
numerology: Five is the number of change and the human experience; here it is the quintessence, the spirit that binds the four elements, expressed through teaching and shared faith.
affirmation: I honour the wisdom of those who came before me and find my own sacred path.

ctx.past: Your roots in this situation lie in tradition, upbringing, or a teacher's influence. Family beliefs, religion, schooling, or a community shaped how you approached this. Some of those lessons still serve you beautifully, while others may be inherited rules you never consciously chose.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter involves structure, convention, or seeking guidance. You may be working within an institution, following established rules, or looking for a mentor. Consider whether the conventional path is right here, and who you are allowing to hold the keys.
ctx.future: Learning, mentorship, or a formal commitment is coming. You may join a group, take a course, find a teacher, or participate in a meaningful ritual or ceremony such as a wedding or initiation. Expect a deepening of belief and a sense of belonging.
ctx.challenge: The Hierophant's shadow is dogma and blind conformity, following rules simply because they exist, or giving your spiritual authority away to someone else. Rigid institutions or judgemental voices may be holding you back. Question gently, and keep what genuinely rings true.
ctx.advice: Seek wisdom from a trusted source. Find a teacher, read the classic texts, or return to rituals that ground you. There is value in proven methods right now. Learn the tradition well, and then you will know when and how to make it your own.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a student, a seeker, or a keeper of knowledge. You may value tradition, loyalty, and doing things properly. Alternatively, you are stepping into the role of teacher. Either way, honour your desire for meaning and for a place in a larger story.
ctx.others: Others may see you as reliable, principled, and conventional, or as a source of wisdom and guidance. There may also be an institution, elder, or mentor in your environment whose expectations shape your choices. Their counsel is worth hearing, though not always obeying.
ctx.hopes: You hope to belong, to find meaning, and to be guided by something trustworthy. You may fear judgement, exclusion, or the disapproval of family or community. Remember that the deepest belonging comes when your beliefs are truly your own.
ctx.love: In love, the Hierophant often points to commitment, marriage, and shared values. Relationships may follow a traditional path or be blessed by family and community. It can also suggest exploring whether you and your partner hold compatible beliefs about how love should look.
ctx.work: At work, this card favours established organisations, education, training, and following proven procedures. A mentor may help your career, or you may become one. It is a good time to earn credentials, learn industry standards, and build reputation through reliability.
ctx.spirit: Spirit calls you toward study and devotion. A spiritual teacher, lineage, or ancestral tradition may be reaching out. Formal ritual, sacred texts, and community practice can deepen your connection now. Your guides remind you that wisdom passed down carries real power.
ctx.release: Let go of beliefs you inherited but never chose, and of institutions or rules that have become cages. Release the need for outside authority to validate your spiritual life. Keep the keys that open doors for you and lay down the ones that only lock you in.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be internalised rules or shame from family, religion, or culture that quietly shape your choices. You may be conforming out of fear rather than conviction. Shine a light on those unspoken expectations so you can choose freely.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lie beliefs, values, and traditions. The matter rests on what you or others consider right and proper. Understanding the teachings and expectations beneath it will reveal why things unfolded the way they did.
ctx.gift: Your gift is access to wisdom: teachers, traditions, and communities ready to support you. You also have the capacity to learn deeply and to pass that knowledge on. Hidden help comes through mentors, elders, and the timeless rituals of your path.

name: VI · The Lovers
imagery: A naked man and woman stand beneath a great winged angel, Raphael, who blesses them from the clouds under a radiant sun. Behind the woman grows a tree of knowledge with a coiled serpent, and behind the man a tree of flames, with a lone mountain rising between them. The figures show innocence and openness, the angel a divine blessing on their union, and the two trees the meeting of desire and wisdom, temptation and spirit, which every true choice must reconcile.
meaning: The Lovers celebrates deep connection, the meeting of two souls or two parts of yourself in harmony. It speaks of romantic love, but also of any union founded on honesty, vulnerability, and shared values. Just as importantly, this is a card of choice: a crossroads where you are asked to choose from the heart and stay true to what you believe. Such decisions shape who you become. Choose with integrity, love with openness, and you will find the blessing of alignment between your desires and your deepest self.
numerology: Six is the number of harmony, love, and balance, where opposites meet in beauty and relationship.
affirmation: I choose love, and I choose in alignment with my truest self.

ctx.past: A significant relationship or meaningful choice shaped where you stand today. Perhaps you fell in love, formed a partnership, or made a decision that defined your values. That union or crossroads left a deep imprint, and its influence is still woven into the present.
ctx.present: At the heart of the matter is a relationship or an important decision. You are being asked to act from your values and to be honest about what you truly want. Whether it involves a partner or a path, harmony comes from aligning heart, mind, and integrity.
ctx.future: A meaningful union or choice is coming. This may bring a new romance, a deepening commitment, or a partnership that feels destined. It may also be a decision point where you choose the path most aligned with who you are becoming. Choose with an open heart.
ctx.challenge: The Lovers' shadow is disharmony between heart and values: indecision, temptation, or choosing what pleases others over what is true. A relationship may be out of balance, or you might be avoiding a decision. Ask which choice your whole self, not just your desire, can stand behind.
ctx.advice: Choose from your values. Be honest and vulnerable with yourself and those you love. If you face a decision, listen to both the flame of desire and the wisdom of experience, then commit. Deep, mutual communication will strengthen any partnership you are in.
ctx.self: You see yourself as someone seeking connection and wholeness. Perhaps you are integrating different parts of yourself, head and heart, light and shadow. Love yourself with the same openness you would offer a beloved, and let your choices express who you truly are.
ctx.others: Others see you as warm, loving, and open-hearted, or as someone at a crossroads. A partner, close friend, or potential love may be strongly present in your environment. How you relate to them, honestly and as equals, will shape this situation significantly.
ctx.hopes: You hope for deep, soulful love and for choices that feel right in your bones. You may also fear choosing wrongly or losing a precious connection. Remember that love based on truth is strong, and a choice made with integrity is never truly a mistake.
ctx.love: This is one of the most beautiful love cards in the deck. It signals deep attraction, soulmate connection, harmony, and commitment. For existing relationships, it speaks of renewed intimacy and alignment. For singles, it can herald meaningful love, but always rooted in honesty and shared values.
ctx.work: At work, the Lovers points to partnerships, collaborations, and important career choices. Choose roles and projects that align with your values rather than only status or money. A harmonious business partnership could flourish now if both parties are genuinely aligned.
ctx.spirit: Spirit blesses the sacred union within you, the meeting of divine masculine and feminine, human and divine. Your guides may be urging you to choose the path of love. This card invites rituals of devotion, heart-opening practice, and honouring the sacred in relationship.
ctx.release: Let go of relationships or choices that conflict with your values, and of indecision that keeps you stuck at the crossroads. Release the fear of vulnerability. Leave behind any love that requires you to betray yourself, making room for one that honours who you are.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be conflicting desires, an attraction you have not admitted, or a decision you are quietly avoiding. You may be projecting your own needs onto a partner. Look honestly at what you really want, because the hidden choice is shaping things already.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies love, attraction, or a defining choice. The whole matter is built on the relationship between two people, two paths, or two parts of you. Understanding the values at stake will reveal what truly drives it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the capacity for deep, authentic connection. You can love wholeheartedly and choose with integrity. Hidden help comes through partnerships and kindred spirits, and the blessing of the angel above suggests that what you choose from love will be supported.

name: VII · The Chariot
imagery: An armoured charioteer stands in a stone chariot beneath a canopy of stars, a laurel crown and eight-pointed star on his head and crescent moons upon his shoulders. Two sphinxes, one black and one white, sit before the chariot pulling in different directions, yet he holds no reins. The sphinxes represent opposing forces he must master through will alone, the starry canopy his celestial protection, and the walled city behind him the world he leaves to claim his victory.
meaning: The Chariot is the triumph of focused will, the moment you take command of conflicting forces and drive them toward a single goal. This card brings determination, ambition, and the self-discipline to keep moving even when the path is rough. It reminds you that victory comes not from forcing the world into line but from mastering yourself, steering contradictory impulses with inner strength rather than reins. Know where you are going, keep your focus, and do not let doubt or distraction pull you off course. Success is within reach if you hold steady.
numerology: Seven is the number of mystery, inner strength, and spiritual seeking; here it is the victory won by uniting will with purpose.
affirmation: I steer my life with focus, courage, and unshakeable will.

ctx.past: Your determination brought you here. In the past you pushed forward through obstacles, mastered conflicting pressures, or won a hard-fought victory. That momentum and the confidence it gave you still carry you, and they prove you can succeed when you commit.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter is about direction and control. You have strong forces at play, perhaps pulling you in opposite ways, and you are being asked to unite them under one clear purpose. Focus, decide where you are going, and drive forward with confidence.
ctx.future: Victory and forward movement are coming. Obstacles will give way to your persistence, and you may see real progress, perhaps literally through travel or a move. Keep your eyes on the goal; the road ahead is open if you hold your course.
ctx.challenge: The Chariot's shadow is control taken too far: forcing outcomes, aggression, or rigid ambition that steamrolls feelings. You may also feel pulled in two directions with no clear aim. Steer with inner discipline rather than brute force, and make sure the sphinxes are heading the same way.
ctx.advice: Set a clear goal and commit to it. Gather your scattered energy and direct it with discipline. Do not wait for perfect conditions; move forward with confidence, keeping emotions steady. Determination and focus will carry you through where hesitation would leave you stuck.
ctx.self: You see yourself as driven, ambitious, and capable of overcoming anything. Or you are being asked to embrace that warrior within. Your armour protects a sensitive heart, as the Cancer link suggests, and your strength lies in moving forward while honouring both.
ctx.others: Others see you as determined, confident, and on the move. Alternatively, someone in your environment is highly driven, competitive, or forceful. Their momentum may help or challenge you; either way, stay in control of your own direction rather than being swept along.
ctx.hopes: You hope for success, victory, and the satisfaction of reaching your goal. You may fear losing control or being pulled off course by forces you cannot manage. Remember the charioteer holds no reins: your power is internal, and it is stronger than you think.
ctx.love: In love, the Chariot suggests pursuing what you want with confidence or moving a relationship forward decisively. It can indicate overcoming obstacles together, such as distance or differing needs. Balance drive with tenderness, ensuring both partners are steering toward the same horizon.
ctx.work: At work, this is a card of ambition and achievement. Projects advance, competitions are won, and goals are reached through hard work and focus. It favours bold career moves, launches, and leadership. Stay organised and disciplined, and you will see clear progress.
ctx.spirit: Spirit encourages you to unite the opposing forces within you, light and dark, instinct and reason, under a higher purpose. Your guides offer protection on your journey, like the starry canopy above. Trust your spiritual will and move forward on your path with confidence.
ctx.release: Let go of inner conflict and the habit of pulling in two directions at once. Release the need to control every outcome or every person. Leave behind distractions and half-hearted pursuits, and free your energy to drive wholeheartedly toward what truly matters.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be conflicting desires you have not reconciled, or a need for control rooted in fear. Your toughness may be armour over vulnerability. Acknowledging the softer feelings beneath your drive will make your will stronger, not weaker.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies willpower and ambition. It is built on someone's determination to succeed and to master competing forces. The core question is whether that drive is aligned with a clear, worthwhile direction.
ctx.gift: Your gift is unstoppable determination. You can overcome obstacles that would halt others and turn conflict into forward movement. Hidden help comes from your own focus and discipline, and the universe tends to make way for someone who knows exactly where they are going.

name: VIII · Strength
imagery: A woman in a white robe and a crown of flowers gently closes the jaws of a great lion, her touch calm rather than forceful. An infinity symbol floats above her head, a garland of roses binds her waist and the lion, and blue mountains rise in the distance. The lion embodies raw passion and instinct, the woman's tender hands the power of love and patience to tame it, and the infinity sign the boundless spiritual strength that flows from inner harmony.
meaning: Strength reveals that true power is quiet: courage softened by compassion, passion guided by patience. This card asks you to meet your fears, anger, or wild instincts not with force but with gentle, steady love. It speaks of resilience, self-belief, and the kind of bravery that keeps going when things are hard. You can handle this situation, and you will do it best by staying calm, kind, and grounded. Befriend your inner lion, and it will become your greatest ally.
numerology: Eight is the number of power, mastery, and infinite cycles; here it shows strength renewed through balance and self-mastery. (In some older decks Strength is numbered XI.)
affirmation: My strength is gentle, patient, and unshakeable.

ctx.past: You have already shown remarkable inner strength. In the past you faced a difficult time, perhaps a fear, temptation, or painful emotion, and met it with courage and patience. That resilience laid the foundation for where you are now, and it remains part of you.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter calls for quiet courage. You may be dealing with strong emotions, a challenging person, or your own wild impulses. Meet them with compassion rather than force. Your calm presence and patience will achieve far more than any struggle could.
ctx.future: Inner strength and confidence are growing. You will soon find you can handle what once intimidated you, and situations will soften under your patient care. Expect a period of resilience, healed confidence, and quiet triumphs that come from gentleness rather than force.
ctx.challenge: The challenge here is self-doubt, or instincts you have been fighting rather than understanding. You may be suppressing anger or desire until it roars, or using force when gentleness is needed. Patience with yourself, not punishment, is the key to taming this lion.
ctx.advice: Approach this with compassionate courage. Breathe, stay calm, and lead with kindness, including toward yourself. Acknowledge your feelings without letting them run the show. Patience and persistence will open the jaws of this problem more gently than any battle.
ctx.self: You see yourself as stronger than you realise, or you are being asked to recognise your own resilience. Your strength is not loud; it is the steady warmth of someone who has faced fear and stayed kind. Honour the brave, tender heart you carry.
ctx.others: Others see you as calm, brave, and quietly powerful, someone who steadies a room. Alternatively, someone in your environment needs gentle handling, or offers you patient support. Your influence here comes through compassion, not command.
ctx.hopes: You hope to feel confident, brave, and in control of your emotions. You may fear that your passions, anger, or anxieties will overwhelm you. The card reassures you: you already hold the strength to soothe the lion, and it does not need to be feared.
ctx.love: In love, Strength brings patience, devotion, and passionate yet gentle connection. It can indicate a relationship that weathers difficulty through mutual care. Be soft with each other, express desire openly, and use compassion to work through tension rather than power struggles.
ctx.work: At work, Strength favours persistence, emotional intelligence, and handling difficult people or projects with grace. Your calm confidence will earn respect. Avoid power plays; instead, lead by quiet example, and trust that steady effort will win the day.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is reminding you of your inner divinity and boundless strength, symbolised by the infinity sign. Your guides encourage practices that unite body and soul, such as breathwork, devotion, or working with animal allies. Love is your most potent magic now.
ctx.release: Let go of the belief that you must be harsh to be strong, or that your feelings are dangerous. Release self-criticism and the fight against your own nature. Leave behind relationships that demand you stay small, and stand in your gentle power.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be suppressed anger, desire, or fear that you have been trying to ignore. Your inner lion wants to be acknowledged, not caged. There may also be greater strength in you than you have admitted. Bring both into the light with compassion.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies inner strength and emotional mastery. It is built on how you handle intense feelings, instincts, or challenges. The core lesson is that gentle persistence and compassion are the true sources of power here.
ctx.gift: Your gift is resilient, compassionate courage. You can face difficult situations without losing your kindness and can calm what others fear. Hidden help comes from your own steady heart, and from the loyal lion of instinct that will fight for you once befriended.

name: IX · The Hermit
imagery: A cloaked old man stands alone on a snowy mountain peak, leaning on a long staff and holding up a lantern in which shines a six-pointed star. His head is bowed, his robe grey and humble, and the darkness around him is quiet and cold. The lantern's star is the light of wisdom he has earned and now offers to others, the staff his patience and experience, and the lonely summit the heights reached only through inner journeying.
meaning: The Hermit invites you to step away from the noise and seek answers within. This is a time for reflection, solitude, and soul-searching, when wisdom comes from quiet contemplation rather than outside advice. You may feel called to withdraw for a while, to study, meditate, or simply spend time with your own thoughts. Far from loneliness, this is a sacred retreat that lets your inner light grow brighter. In time, the Hermit becomes a guide, and the wisdom you find in the dark can light the way for others.
numerology: Nine is the number of completion, wisdom, and spiritual attainment, the final single digit that gathers all experience before a new cycle begins.
affirmation: In stillness, I find my own guiding light.

ctx.past: A time of solitude, reflection, or withdrawal shaped this situation. You may have stepped back to find yourself, or learned from a wise guide. The insights you gained alone in that quieter season still light your way, even if you have since returned to the world.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter is your need for inner guidance. Rather than seeking answers from others, you are being asked to retreat, reflect, and consult your own wisdom. Give yourself space and quiet; the clarity you need will come from within.
ctx.future: A period of introspection and inner discovery is coming. You may choose solitude, study, or a spiritual retreat, and emerge with deep wisdom. A wise mentor might appear. This is not an ending but a pause that brings illumination and a clearer sense of purpose.
ctx.challenge: The Hermit's shadow is isolation that has gone too far: loneliness, withdrawal from loved ones, or overthinking that keeps you stuck on the mountain. You may be hiding from life rather than reflecting on it. Remember the lantern is meant to be shared.
ctx.advice: Make time for solitude. Turn off the noise, walk alone, journal, meditate, or study something that feeds your soul. Seek answers within before asking others. Move slowly and deliberately, and trust that your inner light will show you the next step.
ctx.self: You see yourself as introspective, thoughtful, and perhaps a little apart from others. You value depth over small talk and truth over appearances. Honour your need for quiet, and recognise the hard-won wisdom you carry like a lantern in the dark.
ctx.others: Others may see you as wise, reserved, or distant, someone who keeps to themselves. Alternatively, there is a mentor, teacher, or solitary soul in your environment whose guidance could help. Seek out their quiet counsel; it may illuminate what you cannot yet see.
ctx.hopes: You hope for clarity, peace, and a deep understanding of yourself and your path. You may also fear loneliness or being misunderstood. The Hermit reminds you that solitude chosen with intention is nourishing, and it often leads to more meaningful connection.
ctx.love: In love, the Hermit suggests a time for reflection on what you truly need. Singles may benefit from time alone to know themselves better. In a relationship, partners may need personal space. Honour that space without fear; deep love respects each person's inner journey.
ctx.work: At work, this card favours research, study, specialised expertise, and focused independent work. It may be time to reflect on your career path and whether it fits your soul's purpose. Mentoring others or seeking a mentor can bring valuable direction now.
ctx.spirit: Spirit calls you inward. This is a powerful card for meditation, retreat, and deep spiritual study. A guide or ancestor may appear as a wise elder. Your own inner light is your truest connection to the divine, so tend it carefully and let it shine.
ctx.release: Let go of the need for constant external validation and the noise that drowns out your inner voice. Release distractions, shallow connections, and habits that keep you too busy to reflect. Leave behind what you have outgrown so you can climb toward clarity.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of connection disguised as independence, or loneliness you have not admitted. Alternatively, wisdom is buried within you that you have not yet trusted. Bring your lantern into these shadowed corners and see what you have been avoiding.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a search for meaning and truth. It is built on the need to step back and understand yourself more deeply. The core of the matter will be revealed through quiet reflection rather than outer action.
ctx.gift: Your gift is inner wisdom and the ability to find light in darkness. You can see deeply into situations and offer guidance that others treasure. Hidden help comes from solitude, study, and wise mentors, and your own lantern shines brighter than you know.

name: X · Wheel of Fortune
imagery: A great wheel inscribed with the letters TARO and the Hebrew letters of the divine name turns in a cloudy sky, with alchemical symbols on its spokes. A sphinx with a sword sits atop it, a serpent descends on one side, and the jackal-headed Anubis rises on the other, while winged figures of an angel, eagle, lion, and bull read books in the four corners. The wheel shows the turning cycles of life and fate, the serpent and Anubis the descent and rise of fortune, the sphinx the wisdom that sits above change, and the four creatures the fixed signs holding the world steady.
meaning: The Wheel of Fortune signals that life is turning, and a new chapter is beginning. This card speaks of cycles, fate, synchronicity, and moments when luck shifts in your favour. What goes around comes around, and the seeds you planted before are now returning to you. While you cannot control the wheel, you can choose how you move with it, staying open, adaptable, and ready for opportunity. Trust that change, even unexpected change, is part of a larger pattern working toward your growth.
numerology: Ten is the number of completion and renewal; one and zero together show a cycle closing as a new one begins.
affirmation: I flow with the turning of life and welcome my good fortune.

ctx.past: A turning point in your past set this situation in motion. Perhaps fate brought an unexpected opportunity, or a cycle ended that opened a new one. Lucky timing, chance encounters, or karmic patterns from before are still shaping how things unfold today.
ctx.present: The wheel is turning right now. Circumstances are shifting, and you are at a crossroads of fate. The heart of the matter is change you cannot entirely control but can respond to wisely. Stay alert for synchronicity and opportunities that arrive unexpectedly.
ctx.future: A fortunate change is coming. Luck, new opportunities, and a positive turn of events are on the horizon. A cycle is about to complete and a new one begin. Be ready to seize the moment, because destiny favours those who show up when the wheel turns.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is resisting change, clinging to a phase that is ending, or feeling powerless against forces you cannot control. Repeating patterns may be keeping you stuck. Ask what lesson keeps coming around, and remember you can choose how you meet each turn.
ctx.advice: Go with the flow. Be adaptable, open, and ready to say yes to opportunities. Look for patterns and synchronicities as signs you are on the right path. Do your part, plant good seeds, act with integrity, and trust the wheel to bring the harvest.
ctx.self: You see yourself as someone in transition, or as a person who believes in destiny and meaning. You may sense your life is on the verge of a shift. Embrace your role as an active participant in your fate, both riding the wheel and learning from it.
ctx.others: Others may see you as lucky or as someone experiencing big changes. External circumstances, timing, or other people's decisions might be shifting your situation. Not everything is in your control, but you can stay centred like the sphinx at the top.
ctx.hopes: You hope for good fortune, a lucky break, or a positive change in direction. You may also fear the unpredictability of fate, worried that luck could turn against you. Remember the wheel always keeps turning; difficult times pass, and blessings arrive.
ctx.love: In love, the Wheel of Fortune brings fated meetings, turning points, and karmic connections. A relationship may move to a new stage, or someone from your past may reappear. Trust in divine timing, and stay open to the surprises love may have in store.
ctx.work: At work, expect change, new opportunities, and perhaps a lucky break. Projects may take an unexpected turn, often for the better. It is a good time to be flexible, embrace new directions, and recognise when the timing is right to act on an opportunity.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of cosmic cycles, karma, and divine timing. Your guides remind you that you are part of a greater pattern, and nothing happens without purpose. Work with lunar phases, seasonal cycles, or astrology to align your practice with the turning wheel of the universe.
ctx.release: Let go of trying to control every outcome and of clinging to phases that have run their course. Release old karmic patterns and repeated mistakes. Leave behind the belief that you are unlucky, making room for the new cycle that is ready to begin.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be repeating patterns you have not recognised, or karmic lessons from the past that keep returning. You may unconsciously expect bad luck and block your own blessings. Look for the cycles beneath the surface; awareness is the first step to changing them.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lie cycles, timing, and fate. It was set in motion by forces larger than any single choice. Understanding the patterns and the turning point that started it will reveal what truly lies beneath.
ctx.gift: Your gift is good fortune and impeccable timing. The universe is turning in your favour, bringing opportunities and synchronicities. Hidden help comes through chance, luck, and divine timing, so stay open and ready to catch the blessings as they arrive.
